## Source 1 — Toward Low-Latency End-to-End Voice Agents for Telecommunications Using Streaming ASR, Quantized LLMs, and Real-Time TTS (arXiv 2508.04721, 2025-08-05)

**Type:** Academic paper (arXiv, telecommunications voice-agent architecture)
**Headline:** "Toward Low-Latency End-to-End Voice Agents for Telecommunications Using Streaming ASR, Quantized LLMs, and Real-Time TTS"

### Verbatim excerpts:
> "We introduce a low-latency telecom AI voice agent pipeline for real-time, interactive telecommunications use, enabling advanced voice AI for call center automation, intelligent IVR (Interactive Voice Response), and AI-driven customer support."
> "The solution is built for telecom, combining four specialized models by NetoAI: TSLAM, a 4-bit quantized Telecom-Specific Large Language Model (LLM); T-VEC, a Telecom-Specific Embedding Model; TTE, a Telecom-Specific Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) model; and T-Synth, a Telecom-Specific Text-to-Speech (TTS) model"

### Pain points (verbatim audience language):
- "4-bit quantized LLM" = 模型量化是延迟优化的核心杠杆
- 4 模型 pipeline (TSLAM + T-VEC + TTE + T-Synth) = 不靠一个大模型,靠 4 个垂直小模型级联
- telecom-specific = 通用模型不够,必须有 domain-tuned 专用模型

### Why this works:
The "4-bit 量化 + 4-模型级联" 组合是 Pillar 4 周期最强的工程信号。**延迟优化的杠杆不在 LLM 选型,在量化精度 + 模型拆分**。Pairs with persona's Example 9 (920ms → 640ms latency tuning) — 这次的杠杆是 4-bit quantization 而不只是 prompt 修剪。

**Type:** Vendor comparison (Gradium)
**Headline:** "What Is the Best Text-to-Speech API in 2026 to Build Voice Agents?"

### Verbatim excerpts:
> "TL;DR: Gradium is the best overall TTS API for building voice agents in 2026. It achieves 258ms P50 Time To First Audio (214ms with"

### Pain points (verbatim audience language):
- "258ms P50 Time To First Audio" = TTFA 是新的延迟指标,不只是 end-to-end
- P50 (median) vs P99 分布是生产工程语言

### Why this works:
The "258ms P50 TTFA" 是 Pillar 4 周期最具体的 TTS 单段延迟数字。P50 vs P99 的工程语言 — **生产环境的真实延迟不是平均,是 P50 / P95 / P99 分布**。Pairs with Source 1 的 4-模型级联 — 每个组件的 P50 TTFA 加起来才能算总延迟。

## Source 4 — Best Voice AI for Enterprise Voice Agents (2026) (Inworld AI)

**Type:** Vendor comparison (Inworld)
**Headline:** "Best Voice AI for Enterprise Voice Agents (2026)"

### Verbatim excerpts:
> "Phone conversations have tighter latency requirements than any other voice AI use case. Pauses longer than 300ms feel like the agent is frozen."

### Pain points (verbatim audience language):
- "300ms pauses feel like the agent is frozen" = 人耳对停顿的容忍阈值是 300ms,不是 700ms
- phone = 比其他 voice AI 更紧的延迟要求

### Why this works:
The "300ms 停顿 = 冻屏" 是 Pillar 4 最反直觉的工程真相。**persona 的 sub-700ms 是工程目标,但用户感知的"卡顿"阈值是 300ms**。600ms 的差距 = 工程 KPI 达标但用户仍然觉得慢。

## Source 5 — Build a Real-Time ElevenLabs Voice Agent: 2026 Guide (Deepgram)

**Type:** Vendor engineering guide (Deepgram)
**Headline:** "Build a Real-Time ElevenLabs Voice Agent: 2026 Guide"

### Verbatim excerpts:
> "When STT and endpointing run as separate pipeline stages, every handoff between them adds latency and information loss. Fusing transcription"

### Pain points (verbatim audience language):
- "STT + endpointing" 作为分离 stage = handoff 增延迟 + 信息损失
- "Fusing transcription" = 融合是延迟优化的工程动作

### Why this works:
The "STT + endpointing 融合" 工程动作是 Pillar 4 的工程实操信号。**Latency 不是模型选型,是 pipeline 架构** — 把分离的 stage 融合是新的工程杠杆。Pairs with Source 1 的 4-模型级联 — 垂直拆分 vs 融合,两种相反方向的优化都在被探索。

## Summary for the Researcher

**Macro thesis (Pillar 4):** 2026 H1 voice-agent 工程前沿从"延迟目标"(sub-700ms)推进到"延迟分布"(P50 / P99 TTFA)和"感知阈值"(300ms 停顿 = 冻屏)两个新维度。4-bit quantization + 4-模型级联 (NetoAI arXiv 2508.04721) + STT/endpointing 融合 (Deepgram) + 258ms P50 TTFA (Gradium) + sub-500ms 全球部署 (Cerebrium) 构成 2026 工程的五大杠杆。**延迟优化不再是单一数字,是 5 段 pipeline × 3 个 percentile 分布 × 用户感知阈值的复合工程问题。**

- sub-700ms ceiling + 920ms → 640ms tuning — covered persona Example 9 + 2026-06-18, **饱和**

- LiveKit SFU + WebRTC stack — covered 2026-06-25, **饱和**

- "258ms P50 TTFA" 工程指标 (Source 3) — **FRESH**
- "STT + endpointing 融合" 工程动作 (Source 5) — **FRESH**
